baseline_utilisation.description: Baseline arriving load as a fraction of capacity: throughput F = utilisation * capacity; spare service rate = capacity * (1 - utilisation).
baseline_utilisation.source: ASSUMPTION — the shipped graph carries NO utilisation field on any of its 992 nodes, so a single labelled assumption is used until per-node utilisation data is available. A node may override it with a 'utilisation' field.

closure_capacity_loss.source: Engine validation rule (run API behaviour): kind=closure forces a full loss.

congestion_storage_share.description: Stored-backlog share for no-storage (queue_cap = 0) nodes in the service-time delay function.
congestion_storage_share.source: ASSUMPTION — a node with queue_cap = 0 has no storage: only this share of its backlog is held in transit (slow-steaming / dwell); the rest is diverted or unmet and does not wait at the node.

cost_delay_scale_d.description: Cost-leaf magnitude = min(1, winning parent elapsed time / this scale).
cost_delay_scale_d.source: ASSUMPTION — hand-set scale, registered unchanged. Cost magnitude is expedite pressure (dimensionless), never currency.

cost_gate_d.description: A non-hit node records a cost leaf only when the winning parent's accumulated elapsed time reaches this gate.

default_capacity_loss.description: Capacity loss used for non-closure kinds whose spec omits capacity_loss.
default_capacity_loss.source: Engine validation default (run API behaviour), registered unchanged.

default_duration_d.description: Duration used when a disruption spec omits duration_d.
default_duration_d.source: Engine validation default (run API behaviour), registered unchanged.

delay_hit_floor_d.description: Delay floor for the delay-based hit test (evaluated on the continuous service-time wait).
delay_hit_floor_d.source: Hit rule: a node is also hit when its added wait reaches 1.0 d, provided the shortfall is material.

duration_max_d.description: Maximum accepted duration_d (rejected beyond, never clamped).
duration_max_d.source: Engine validation bound, set to 3650 so real replay durations (Red Sea 559 d) are not rejected; registered unchanged.

hit_threshold_default.description: Default hit threshold: a node is hit when its total shortfall fraction reaches this value (node hit_threshold and per-run overrides take precedence).
hit_threshold_default.source: Run parameter; default value of engine.DEFAULT_PARAMS.

inventory_gate_days.description: Minimum inventory_days for the inventory channel label.
inventory_gate_days.source: Inventory channel gate: the inventory channel label applies only at nodes carrying at least this many days of inventory cover. (The buffer itself — inventory_days absorbing shortfall-days before propagation — applies at every node that carries cover.)

max_events.description: Run aborts with a runaway error beyond this many events.
max_events.source: Structural runaway guard (quiescence bound), not a model parameter.

max_layers.description: Run aborts with a runaway error beyond this many cascade layers.
max_layers.source: Structural runaway guard (quiescence bound), not a model parameter.

max_utilisation.description: Per-node utilisation values are clamped to this ceiling inside the service-time model.
max_utilisation.source: ASSUMPTION — numerical guard so the spare service rate C*(1-u) never reaches zero and waits stay finite.

mean_wait_factor.description: Mean-wait factor in the service-time delay function: wait = queue_sensitivity * mean_wait_factor * stored_backlog / spare_rate.
mean_wait_factor.source: ASSUMPTION — fluid-queue triangular backlog profile: backlog rises linearly then clears, so the MEAN wait of affected flow is half the clearance time of the stored backlog.

min_material_share.description: Minimum shortfall fraction for a delay-floor hit or a cost leaf.
min_material_share.source: ASSUMPTION — guard so clock quantisation / tiny shares cannot mint hits on dense graphs; retained as the materiality floor for delay-floor hits and cost leaves.

mode_shift_transit_fraction.description: Mode-shift added wait = this fraction * edge base_transit_d * total shortfall at the child.

pulse_duration_factor.source: Shape semantics: a pulse delivers the full loss for half the duration.

queue_sensitivity_default.description: Default for the queue_sensitivity run parameter; callers may override within bounds (rejected, never clamped).
queue_sensitivity_default.source: Run parameter; default value of engine.DEFAULT_PARAMS.

ramp_loss_factor.source: Shape semantics: a ramp averages half the peak loss over the duration.

reroute_propagate_fraction.description: Fraction of a reroute arrival's shortfall that propagates onward when the reroute arrival is itself a first hit.

upstream_attenuation.description: Fraction of a hit node's shortfall that backs up to an upstream supplier over each inbound edge.

model_revision: Engine model revision 2 (versioned constants registry; absolute-flow aggregation and service-time delay)
